name: Infidelity
overview: Scripture affirms the sanctity of the marital union, emphasizing that a man shall leave his parents and be united to his wife, becoming one flesh, as stated in Genesis 2:24. The subtlety of deception, illustrated by the serpent's lies in Genesis 3, serves as a warning against unfaithfulness and disobedience to God's commands. The resistance to God's authority, seen in Pharaoh's refusal to acknowledge the LORD in Exodus 5:2 and the Israelites' complaints in Exodus 14, parallels the spiritual unfaithfulness that breaks covenantal bonds. Together, these passages highlight the seriousness of infidelity both in marriage and in our relationship with God.
